facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹2.23 lakh cr, +27% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹21,446 cr, +38% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹57,553 cr (+25% YoY), PAT ₹5,167 cr (+30% YoY), operating margin 17.8%.
Revenue has compounded at 10% over 10 years, 22% over 5 and 18% over 3; the last twelve months (+27%) are running ahead of the 3-year pace.
Profit has compounded faster than revenue over 3 years (23% vs 18%): operating leverage is working.
Operating margin has compressed to 17.8% from 19.4% a year ago (−1.6 pp).
Borrowings are ₹1.54 lakh cr against equity of ₹97,917 cr: debt/equity 1.57× (was 1.64× in Mar 2023).
Gross debt is 3.7× trailing operating profit — more than three years of EBITDA.
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 4.6× over the last twelve months.
The cash conversion cycle has shortened to −30 days from −13 in Mar 2023 (inventory days 83 → 65, payable days 118 → 112).
Promoters hold 18.4%, unchanged over a year.
Foreign institutions hold 33.3%, −4.7 pp over a year.
Over 5 years, ₹11,377 cr of operating cash came from ₹1.27 lakh cr of operating profit: 9% conversion; against PAT of ₹63,592 cr that is 0.2×.
Free cash flow was negative in 3 of the last 5 years; cumulative −₹29,304 cr, latest year ₹2,545 cr.
Capex ran at 5% of revenue in Mar 2026, about ₹9,112 cr (averaged 6% over the three years before).

business.what: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd is the flagship company of the Mahindra Group, operating in automotive and farm equipment sectors. It manufactures and sells vehicles (SUVs, commercial vehicles) and tractors, while also managing a diversified portfolio of investments in subsidiaries and joint ventures.
